cases.description: One upright frame: every joint present, the root at the origin.
cases.name: standing

cases.description: Only the nose and the left ear are detected: the head is their mean, its confidence the mean of theirs.
cases.name: partial_face

cases.description: No face keypoint is detected: the head is missing, nothing else.
cases.name: no_face

cases.description: The left elbow is not detected, so the left wrist, its child, is missing too.
cases.name: missing_elbow

cases.description: In the second frame the right shoulder is not detected: there is no neck, so both shoulders, both arms and the head are missing; the legs stay. The first frame gives the torso length.
cases.name: missing_shoulder

cases.description: The right knee sits exactly on the right hip: a zero-length bone, so the knee is missing and the ankle with it.
cases.name: coincident_knee

cases.description: The middle frame is missing its left hip: no root, so it is a gap frame. Center and scale come from the other two.
cases.name: gap_frame

cases.description: Four frames rising and falling, the body growing in the picture: the root moves in torso lengths about the sequence's mean root, scaled by the median torso over four frames (the mean of the middle two).
cases.name: jump

cases.description: Both shoulders are missing in every frame: there is no torso length to scale by, so the transform has no output (null).
cases.name: no_torso
